description: Drive the existing kernel make with clang/lld in a separate compile dir (GENERIC_CLANG), produce a linked ELF with no unresolved symbols, matching assym.h, and compare against the GCC reference. Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: Create the separate build dir ~/obj-luna88k/sys/arch/luna88k/compile/GENERIC_CLANG (seed by running ~/tools-luna88k/bin/nbconfig on a copy of conf GENERIC named GENERIC_CLANG, or copy Makefile+opt_*.h+*.h+ioconf.c/swapnetbsd.c from GENERIC without the .o files; check how GENERIC was configured by reading its Makefile header and the nbconfig invocation in ~/build-*.log). Leave GENERIC untouched. Copy the GCC reference ELF to clang-netbsd-kernel/netbsd.gcc-ref (exists already; do not overwrite original).

Write wrapper script /home/mk2s/Documents/llvm-m88k/.agents/tasks/clang-netbsd-kernel/clang-wrapper.sh (exec build/bin/clang --target=m88k-unknown-netbsd -mcpu=mc88100 -fno-pie -fno-builtin if needed, no FP use, the -std chosen in FEAT-001, the -Wno-* list from FEAT-001, then "$@"). Must handle -x assembler-with-cpp -traditional-cpp (replace/drop -traditional-cpp if clang rejects it) and -D_LOCORE for .S. Pass overrides on the nbmake command line: CC=wrapper LD=ld.lld AR=llvm-ar RANLIB=llvm-ranlib NM=llvm-nm SIZE=llvm-size (or a shell wrapper using llvm-objdump if llvm-size is absent) STRIP=llvm-strip OBJCOPY=llvm-objcopy; note _ISGCC295 does a '${CC} --version | grep 2.95' check, harmless. Command-line variables override makefile assignments, so CFLAGS/CWARNFLAGS cannot be appended on the command line; use the wrapper for extras. Only if unavoidable make small portable edits to sys/conf/Makefile.kern.inc or arch/luna88k/conf/Makefile.luna88k.

Linking: ld.lld flags equivalent to GCC's ld: -N -Ttext 0x20000 -e start -S (-X for debug); check lld accepts -N with -Ttext and does not emit PT_PHDR/GNU_STACK oddities; compare program headers with llvm-readelf -l of the GCC ref (build/bin/llvm-readelf). Use -z norelro / --no-rosegment / -z noseparate-code or --image-base if needed so the load layout matches (single RWX segment at 0x20000). Consider --no-warn-mismatch, big-endian automatically from the m88k target.

assym.h: run nbmake assym.h in GENERIC_CLANG; diff <(sort ~/obj-luna88k/.../GENERIC/assym.h) <(sort GENERIC_CLANG/assym.h). genassym.sh does '$CC ... -S -o -' then sed 's/.*XYZZY/#define/'; if clang asm output changes formatting (e.g. '$' or '#' handling, .ascii form, operand prefix) fix with minimal change to sys/kern/genassym.sh valid for gcc output; document.

Build everything: nbmake-luna88k -j8 netbsd with the overrides; handle libkern (libkern is built into the kernel via LIBKERN objects; check m88k libkern Makefile.inc/arch/m88k/libkern), libcompat, vers.c via newvers.sh. Resolve unresolved symbols: expect compiler-runtime helpers (__udivdi3, __divdi3, __moddi3, __umoddi3, __ashldi3, __lshrdi3, __ashrdi3, __muldi3, __mulsi3, __udivsi3/__divsi3, memcpy/memset/memmove emitted by clang, __builtin helpers). Check libkern for existing implementations (sys/lib/libkern/*.c, arch/m88k/libkern or lib/libkern/arch/m88k); add missing ones in sys/lib/libkern in a GCC-compatible way, otherwise link compiler-rt builtins built for m88k or define via clang flags. Verify with ld.lld --no-undefined (default for static link) and llvm-nm -u.

Final image: GCC build's final step is just ELF 'netbsd' (SYSTEM_LD_TAIL: size + chmod, plus strip -d -o netbsd netbsd.gdb when DEBUG=-g). mdsetimage applies only to RAMDISK; m88k-elf2aout is only for stand/boot (ELF2AOUT_OPTS=-O). Read arch/luna88k/stand/boot/boot.c and Makefile to confirm the boot loader loads ELF kernels (e.g. via loadfile/ELF) and confirm the clang kernel needs no extra conversion; mirror how the GCC netbsd was stripped (check llvm-strip vs strip -d / debug sections).

Comparison report in clang-netbsd-kernel/compare.md: llvm-readelf -h/-l/-S of both ELFs (entry point, load addresses, section sizes), llvm-nm symbol diff (missing/extra in each direction), assym.h diff result, and an ABI risk review of hand-written asm (arch/luna88k/luna88k/locore.S, arch/m88k/m88k/*.S, eh/trap entry) calling C: register usage, delay-slot/branch conventions, struct offsets from assym.h, anything depending on GCC-specific asm constraints or inline asm in headers (grep __asm in arch/m88k/include and arch/luna88k/include; ensure clang inline asm constraints produce correct code).

Commit any NetBSD source/Makefile changes on clang-luna88k-kernel (git add specific files). Commit wrapper/script files only in the task dir (not tracked) or, if small and clean, as sys/arch/luna88k/conf/ helper on the NetBSD branch; document the decision in the README draft.
acceptance_criteria: nbmake-luna88k with clang overrides produces GENERIC_CLANG/netbsd with no GCC invoked (confirm by build log containing no m88k--netbsdelf3-gcc/ld invocations)
llvm-nm -u on netbsd shows no undefined symbols
sorted assym.h from clang equals sorted GCC assym.h, or differences are explained and harmless
compare.md exists with section sizes, symbol diff, entry/load addrs and ABI risks
GCC reference artifacts in GENERIC unchanged (netbsd still 1735468 bytes, mtime unchanged)
verification: Run the documented nbmake command in GENERIC_CLANG and confirm exit 0
findings:
GENERIC_CLANG/netbsd built and linked: exit 0, 0 undefined symbols (llvm-nm -u), no m88k--netbsdelf3-* tool invoked. Build command (full build ~6 s): sh /home/mk2s/Documents/llvm-m88k/.agents/tasks/clang-netbsd-kernel/build.sh [target, default netbsd]. It runs nbmake-luna88k -j8 NO_M88K_MOVSTR=1 EXTRA_LINKFLAGS="-z nognustack" CC=clang-wrapper.sh LD=build/bin/ld.lld AR=llvm-ar RANLIB=llvm-ranlib NM=llvm-nm STRIP=llvm-strip OBJCOPY=llvm-objcopy SIZE="llvm-objdump -h" in ~/obj-luna88k/sys/arch/luna88k/compile/GENERIC_CLANG (made with: cd netbsd-src/sys/arch/luna88k/conf; nbconfig -b <dir> -s netbsd-src/sys GENERIC; no 'make depend' needed). To force a full rebuild: find GENERIC_CLANG -name '*.o' -o -name '*.a' | xargs rm.
Wrapper: /home/mk2s/Documents/llvm-m88k/.agents/tasks/clang-netbsd-kernel/clang-wrapper.sh = clang --target=m88k-unknown-netbsd -mcpu=mc88100 -fno-pie -std=gnu89 -fcommon [-fno-integrated-as only if -S given] "$@" then the 19 FEAT-001 -Wno-* flags (they must come after "$@" to override -Wstrict-prototypes): -Wno-deprecated-non-prototype -Wno-strict-prototypes -Wno-header-guard -Wno-gnu-folding-constant -Wno-pointer-sign -Wno-unused-but-set-variable -Wno-knr-promoted-parameter -Wno-format-security -Wno-shift-negative-value -Wno-constant-conversion -Wno-incompatible-pointer-types-discards-qualifiers -Wno-pointer-compare -Wno-unused-function -Wno-enum-conversion -Wno-parentheses-equality -Wno-array-parameter -Wno-misleading-indentation -Wno-constant-logical-operand -Wno-tautological-constant-compare. -fcommon needed (11 duplicate-symbol link errors otherwise). -fno-integrated-as for -S needed because genassym.sh XYZZY inline asm is parsed by the integrated assembler (genassym.sh unchanged). No -traditional-cpp problem: clang ignores it with an unused-argument warning.
NetBSD changes (committed on clang-luna88k-kernel): sys/lib/libkern/{memcmp,memset,strcmp,strcpy,strlen}.c add '#undef <name>' after libkern.h (libkern.h maps to __builtin_*; clang rejects defining builtin); sys/lib/libkern/arch/m88k/Makefile.inc skips the GCC-only move*.s __movstr helpers when NO_M88K_MOVSTR is set (default unchanged). GCC 3.3.6 recompiles the 5 changed files OK; Makefile.inc default still lists move*.s. GCC reference GENERIC/netbsd unchanged (1735468 bytes, mtime 2026-09-28 10:00:04.834972645).
LLVM change (committed on clang-netbsd-kernel): lld/ELF/Writer.cpp: with -N, etext was 0x1034 (no RO PT_LOAD); pmap.c uses &etext to split RO text from RW data, so the kernel would have mis-mapped. Now etext = end of last RO alloc section (0x1930b0). ninja -C build lld was rebuilt. New test lld/test/ELF/etext-omagic.s (REQUIRES: m88k, shows UNSUPPORTED under lit since no m88k lit feature; RUN steps verified manually).
assym.h: identical to GCC's after sort, modulo whitespace (GCC '#define<TAB> NAME VAL', clang '#define NAME VAL').
Image: single RWX PT_LOAD at 0x20000, entry 0x20000, same ELF32 BE MC88000 EXEC format as GCC (with -z nognustack no GNU_STACK). Clang kernel ELF is 1789592 bytes, memsz 0x191fe4 vs GCC 0x1810e0; .symtab present; no post-processing (no strip -d needed since DEBUG unset, no mdsetimage, no elf2aout). Symbols: 4063 vs 4159 global; missing only the 87 __movstr*, __ashldi3/__ashrdi3/__lshrdi3/__cmpdi2/__ucmpdi2/__negdi2 (libkern members unused), __bss_start/_edata/_end (ld script symbols). Nothing extra in clang.
Report: clang-netbsd-kernel/compare.md (sizes, phdrs, symbol diff, ABI review). ABI risks for boot: ddb trace prologue parsing (db_trace.c) is GCC-specific; check hand asm at boot.
Boot for FEAT-003 (exploration only; no boot result yet): nono -c cfg -X <elf> loads the kernel directly (PC starts at ROM 0x0, kernel entry reached). hostcom-driver=stdio and -D debugger stdio fail without a tty; use hostcom-driver=tcp (listens on IPv6 ::1 only, connect to ::1:<port>, port 20123 used) and debugger-driver=tcp (-d -V debugger-driver=tcp -V debugger-tcp-port=N; debugger commands c/s/r/m/d/b). With the GCC reference kernel, hostcom0 gave only telnet IAC bytes and no text within 20 s, while the debugger showed the kernel spinning in a console putc loop polling the SIO at 0x5100000c (status of channel B at 0x51000008), i.e. the console is on SIO channel B, possibly not wired to hostcom0 (try hostcom1-driver=tcp, hostcom1-tcp-port, or dipsw settings) or output was missed before connecting. sysconsole=1 default (keyboard/bitmap) vs 0 (ttya) is set in machdep.c. The GCC kernel must be used as the baseline in FEAT-003. Helper scripts were not kept (removed boot-nono.sh); /tmp/nb/dbg.py (debugger+hostcom driver) may still exist.
